title: VirSME Connect | Business Communication in Operating Context
description: Connect business communication and collaboration to the people, customers and work it is about.
hero: Communication should not live outside the work it is about.
intro: VirSME Connect brings business communication and collaboration into the same operating context as people, work and customers.

blocks.text: Reduce the gap between conversation and action
Turn important conversations into accountable next steps without forcing users to reconstruct context in another tool.
Announcements, discussions and workplace communication can remain tied to the relevant employee, customer, project or workflow context.

items: Stronger connection between communication and execution
